title: TurkaGame manuscript asset provenance record
description: One record per curated image under assets/manuscripts/. Every field marked required must be filled before an asset's usage_status can be 'approved'.

id.description: Stable unique id (uuid4), assigned by register_asset.py.

title.description: Human-readable description of what the image depicts.

date_or_period.description: Date or period of the source object, e.g. 'copied 1420-25' or 'ca. 15th c.'.

digitization_source_url.description: URL of the digital library / catalog entry the image was sourced from, if any.

rights_note.description: Rights/licensing status as best determined (e.g. public domain, institution's stated terms, fair-use-for-scholarship rationale). Must be non-empty before 'approved'.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the local file, for integrity checking.

cited_in.description: research/sources.json ids or research/notes/*.md filenames this asset traces back to.

usage_status.description: candidate = logged but not cleared for use in a game; approved = rights_note confirmed, safe to use; rejected = investigated and ruled out.
